results.name: AC-R6 state drift is refused even though the PLAN is unchanged
AC-R7 EXCLUSIVITY gap: the writer layer installs under an unseen drift

detail.honest_scope: the CREDENTIAL layer (AC-R6) does refuse the drift; the WRITER layer (`InstallLedger.finish`, d3_geo_adapter.py:666-689) never consults the credential, it only compares `plan_hash` -- so the two layers are not composed and exclusivity holds only where the credential is consulted

results.name: AC-R8 ONE-TIME-USE: the gate is a pure function and can be replayed

gate_layer.why: pre_install_reverify(cred_cert, cred_install, ...) is a pure function of its arguments; there is no nonce, counter or sequence, so the same credential authorises arbitrarily many submissions

writer_layer.why: InstallLedger.finish has a per-OBJECT `finished` guard, so reuse is refused only while the SAME ledger object is reused -- a fresh ledger with the same credential is not refused

results.name: AC-R9 FAILURE CONSISTENCY: a raising install_fn leaves an unreported partial write

detail.exception_escaped: RuntimeError: install_fn failed after mutating the first vehicle
detail.why: `d3_geo_adapter.py:689` calls `self.install_fn(plan)` outside any guard and sets `finished` only AFTER it returns, so an exception escapes with n_installs==0, no event, finished==False and the next finish() free to install again
detail.no_crash_recovery_claimed: H5: there is no durable transaction mechanism, so NOTHING here may be described as crash-recovery atomicity

results.name: AC-R10 PROBE ONLY: installable is reachable solely via an injected quality check

detail.why: answers "is the gate discriminating or a wall?": every executable check already passes, so the D8 capability gap is the ONLY blocker -- and injecting a fake quality check is what flips `installable`. That injection is diagnostic only; no install permission is claimed and D8 is not relaxed
